mentions.name: BuildBound
mentions.description: This application provides an interactive zoning and land-use map for New York City that makes it easy to see which parcels are upzoned under the City of Yes housing changes passed last year. It began as a service to connect people interested in ADUs with architects and contractors, and is being developed into the best interactive zoning/land-use map in NYC, with potential to crunch eligibility numbers (such as TOD upzoning qualification) and provide them as a public service.
mentions.problem: It is currently very hard to tell whether a given site qualifies for the TOD upzoning portion of the City of Yes.
mentions.audience: People interested in ADUs in NYC (originally to be connected with architects and contractors); zoning eligibility information offered as a public service
mentions.source_excerpt: Started working on an application to make it easy to see what parcels in NYC are upzoned with the City of Yes[1] changes that were passed last year.
